mapper.insert: insert into outbound_material(outbound_record_id, warehouse_material_id, material_id, outbound_num, create_by, remark, create_time) values (#{outboundRecordId}, #{warehouseMaterialId}, #{materialId}, #{outboundNum}, #{createBy}, #{remark}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: select om.*, m.name as material_name, m.spec, m.price, mt.name as type_name from outbound_material om left join material m on om.material_id = m.id left join material_type mt on m.type_id = mt.id where om.outbound_record_id = #{outboundRecordId} order by om.id
